title_zh: 全球健康与长寿每日简报
intro_zh: 每日汇总功能医学、长寿医学、精准营养、营养补剂与健康管理五大领域的中英文权威资讯，每条附原始出处链接。
intro_en: A daily digest of authoritative Chinese and international coverage across functional medicine, longevity medicine, precision nutrition, dietary supplements and health management — every item linked to its original source.

items.title_zh: 中国医学救援协会全科医学年会在上海举行：功能医学理念融入全科慢病管理
items.title_en: Chinese Association of General Practice Annual Meeting in Shanghai: Functional Medicine Integrated into Chronic Disease Management
items.summary_zh: 中国医学救援协会2026全科医学分会学术年会在上海举行。中国功能医学研究院李绍清博士围绕功能医学与现代医疗展开研讨，探索功能医学理念融入全科慢病管理的实践路径；会议同时交流了氢医学基础研究与哮喘等慢性气道疾病的个体化管理思路，推动前沿技术向基层临床下沉。
items.summary_en: The 2026 annual meeting of the Chinese Association of General Practice (Medical Rescue Association) was held in Shanghai. Dr. Li Shaoqing of the Chinese Institute of Functional Medicine explored how functional medicine concepts can be integrated into general-practice chronic disease management, alongside sessions on hydrogen medicine and individualized airway disease care, pushing frontier approaches into primary care.

items.title_zh: KETOCOMP真实世界研究：食物基序贯生酮方案助地中海饮食无应答复杂肥胖者减脂23%
items.title_en: KETOCOMP Real-World Study: Food-Based Sequential Ketogenic Protocol Cuts Fat Mass 23% in Mediterranean Diet Non-Responders
items.summary_zh: 罗马Gemelli医院临床营养团队发表于Nutrients的KETOCOMP观察研究显示，对低热量地中海饮食无应答的复杂肥胖患者，采用4周食物基生酮（约1200千卡/日）加4周低碳水再引入的医学监督序贯方案后，全流程体重、BMI与脂肪量分别下降7.7%、9.45%与23.1%，为临床营养二线干预提供了可操作的路径。
items.summary_en: The KETOCOMP observational study from Gemelli Hospital's clinical nutrition unit, published in Nutrients, shows that complicated obesity patients non-responsive to a hypocaloric Mediterranean diet achieved 7.7% body weight, 9.45% BMI and 23.1% fat mass reductions across a medically supervised sequence of a 4-week food-based ketogenic phase (~1200 kcal/day) plus 4-week low-carb reintroduction — a workable second-line clinical nutrition pathway.

items.title_zh: 个体化医学营养治疗12周：2型糖尿病患者血糖与炎症、肠屏障标志物同步改善
items.title_en: 12 Weeks of Individualized Medical Nutrition Therapy Improves Glycemia and Inflammatory, Gut-Barrier Markers in Type 2 Diabetes
items.summary_zh: 发表于Nutrition的一项随机对照试验纳入46名口服降糖药的2型糖尿病患者，个体化医学营养治疗组每周随访，12周后糖化血红蛋白平均下降1.54个百分点、空腹血糖降约57mg/dL，TNF-α、IL-6及循环zonulin同步下降，提示个体化营养干预的影响或超出血糖范畴；作者强调zonulin证据仍属初步。
items.summary_en: A randomized trial in Nutrition enrolled 46 adults with type 2 diabetes on oral agents; the individualized medical nutrition therapy group with weekly follow-up achieved a mean 1.54-point HbA1c drop and ~57 mg/dL fasting glucose reduction over 12 weeks, with TNF-alpha, IL-6 and circulating zonulin also falling — hinting benefits beyond glucose, though the authors stress the zonulin findings remain preliminary.

items.title_zh: 谷医堂'九科协同'慢病管理模式：功能医学检测与中医体质辨证数据融合
items.title_en: Guyitang's 'Nine-Specialty Collaboration' Chronic Disease Model Fuses Functional Medicine Testing with TCM Constitution Profiling
items.summary_zh: 谷医堂披露其中西协同'九科协同'慢病管理实践：旗下华务星辰实验室开展功能医学、代谢指标与慢病风险检测并提供居家采样，将检验微观数据与中医体质辨证、舌脉信息结合形成量化健康数据库，由医师、营养师、健管师等协同小组动态调整干预方案，线上服务用户累计已突破千万人次。
items.summary_en: Guyitang detailed its integrated 'nine-specialty collaboration' chronic disease model: its Huawu Xingchen lab offers functional medicine, metabolic and chronic disease risk testing with at-home sampling, merging lab data with TCM constitution profiling into a quantified health database, while a physician-dietitian-health coach team dynamically adjusts interventions; its online services have surpassed 10 million cumulative users.

items.title_zh: 第七届时光派国际长寿论坛在沪举行，沙利文《2026全球长寿诊所医学干预分级及落地指南》双语发布
items.title_en: 7th TimePie International Longevity Forum Held in Shanghai; Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Global Longevity Clinic Intervention Grading Guide Released Bilingually
items.summary_zh: 第七届时光派国际长寿论坛汇聚哈佛医学院、耶鲁、哥伦比亚、新加坡国立等学者与诺华、基因泰克等企业代表，4000余人参会。论坛期间发布的《2026全球长寿诊所医学干预分级及落地指南》系统梳理长寿医学评估体系、干预技术图谱与落地路径，其营养干预章节指出行业正从'原料质量'转向'完整产品质量'竞争。
items.summary_en: The 7th TimePie International Longevity Forum brought together researchers from Harvard Medical School, Yale, Columbia and NUS along with Novartis and Genentech representatives, drawing 4,000+ attendees. The bilingual 2026 Global Longevity Clinic Intervention Grading & Implementation Guide maps assessment systems, intervention technologies and commercialization paths; its nutrition chapter notes a shift from 'raw material quality' to 'complete product evidence' as the competitive frontier.

items.title_zh: ScienceDaily：调整饮食结构仅4周，老年人生物年龄指标即出现逆转迹象
items.title_en: ScienceDaily: Older Adults Show Biological Age Reversal Signs After Just 4 Weeks of Dietary Restructuring
items.summary_zh: 9月15日报道的一项研究显示，改变饮食中脂肪、碳水化合物与动物蛋白平衡的老年人，仅在四周后就表现出生物年龄降低的迹象，其中采用杂食性低脂饮食的参与者效果最强。该结果为'短周期营养干预即可影响表观遗传年龄'提供了新证据，但长期效应与机制仍待更大规模试验验证。
items.summary_en: A study reported on September 15 found that older adults who rebalanced dietary fat, carbohydrate and animal protein showed signs of reduced biological age after only four weeks, with the strongest effects in omnivorous low-fat diet participants. The results add evidence that short-cycle nutritional interventions can shift epigenetic age, though long-term effects need larger trials.

items.title_zh: iScience：幼年高脂饮食造成的线粒体损伤，成年后可用烟酰胺核苷、α-KG或益生菌部分逆转
items.title_en: iScience: Early-Life High-Fat Diet Mitochondrial Damage Can Be Partially Reversed in Adulthood with NR, Alpha-KG or Probiotics
items.summary_zh: 《iScience》最新研究通过多组学分析发现，生命早期高脂饮食会永久性抑制脂肪组织三羧酸循环与氧化磷酸化基因、损伤线粒体功能并持久重塑肠道菌群。研究证实，成年后补充NAD前体烟酰胺核苷、三羧酸循环中间体α-酮戊二酸或特定共生菌，可恢复线粒体氧化还原平衡、提升呼吸能力并延长寿命，为幼年肥胖导致的成年代谢危机提供逆转靶点。
items.summary_en: A new iScience multi-omics study shows early-life high-fat diet exposure durably suppresses TCA cycle and oxidative phosphorylation genes in adipose tissue, impairs mitochondrial bioenergetics and permanently reshapes gut microbiota. In adulthood, supplementing the NAD precursor nicotinamide riboside, the TCA intermediate alpha-ketoglutarate, or specific commensal microbes restored mitochondrial redox balance, improved respiration and extended lifespan — offering reversal targets for metabolic sequelae of childhood obesity.

items.title_zh: Sabinsa长寿配方研讨会前瞻：四氢姜黄素SIRT1人体证据缺口与衰老替代终点之辩
items.title_en: Sabinsa Longevity Formulation Webinar Preview: The Tetrahydrocurcuminoid SIRT1 Human Evidence Gap and the Debate Over Aging Surrogate Endpoints
items.summary_zh: Nutrition Insight对话Sabinsa欧洲总裁Umar Jan：四氢姜黄素延寿数据源自果蝇Sir2/FOXO机制，直接链接SIRT1的人体临床证据仍属空白；其AMPK激活效力约为姜黄素250倍使通路具生物学合理性，EFSA评定成人安全上限为140mg/日。文章还讨论GrimAge、PhenoAge与IL-6等替代终点的取舍——单一指标皆不可尽信。
items.summary_en: Nutrition Insight spoke with Sabinsa's European president Dr. Umar Jan: tetrahydrocurcuminoid lifespan data come from Drosophila Sir2/FOXO mechanisms, and direct human clinical evidence linking intake to SIRT1 activation remains an open gap; ~250-fold higher AMPK activation potency versus curcumin lends plausibility, while EFSA caps adult intake at 140 mg/day. The piece also weighs GrimAge, PhenoAge and IL-6 as surrogate endpoints — none trustworthy in isolation.

items.title_zh: Nature Chemical Biology：机器学习+机器人自动化设计'纤维-菌株'组合，精准定向产出丁酸
items.title_en: Nature Chemical Biology: Machine Learning Plus Robotic Automation Designs Fiber-Strain Combos for Targeted Butyrate Production
items.source_zh: Global Prebiotic Association / Nature Chemical Biology
items.source_en: Global Prebiotic Association / Nature Chemical Biology
items.summary_zh: 杜克大学与华盛顿大学团队将机器学习、贝叶斯优化与机器人自动化结合，经五轮'设计-构建-测试-学习'循环，从万亿级组合中锁定菊粉+普通拟杆菌+产丁酸厌氧杆菌组合，可稳定高产丁酸，并在真实人体粪便样本中复现。该框架表明'膳食纤维'不应视为可互换的单一成分，为精准益生元配方设计提供新范式。
items.summary_en: Duke and University of Washington researchers combined machine learning, Bayesian optimization and robotic automation in five design-build-test-learn rounds to identify — from trillions of possible combos — an inulin + Bacteroides uniformis + Anaerostipes caccae pairing that reliably yields high butyrate, reproduced in real human fecal samples. The framework argues dietary fiber should not be treated as interchangeable, setting a new paradigm for precision prebiotic design.

items.title_zh: Nutrients肠-皮肤轴综述：菌群代谢物如何介导膳食生物活性物与皮肤衰老
items.title_en: Nutrients Gut-Skin Axis Review: How Microbial Metabolites Mediate Dietary Bioactives and Skin Aging
items.summary_zh: 9月16日发表于Nutrients的综述系统梳理肠-皮肤轴：多酚、多糖、类胡萝卜素、益生菌与后生元等膳食生物活性物经菌群生物转化生成的SCFAs、吲哚衍生物、尿石素与胆汁酸衍生物，可能中介氧化应激、炎症、线粒体功能与细胞衰老等皮肤衰老通路；但人群因果证据仍有限，个体菌群代谢能力差异或致干预反应异质。
items.summary_en: A review published September 16 in Nutrients maps the gut-skin axis: dietary bioactives such as polyphenols, polysaccharides and carotenoids are microbially transformed into SCFAs, indole derivatives, urolithins and bile acid metabolites that may mediate oxidative stress, inflammation, mitochondrial function and cellular senescence pathways in skin aging — though human causal evidence remains limited and interindividual metabolic capacity may drive heterogeneous responses.

items.title_zh: 韩国大型队列锁定内脏脂肪相关菌群：Dorea与青春双歧杆菌经糖原合成通路促脂堆积
items.title_en: Large Korean Cohort Pinpoints Visceral Fat-Linked Microbes: Dorea and B. adolescentis Drive Fat Accumulation via Glycogen Synthesis Pathway
items.summary_zh: 9月10日发表于《Experimental & Molecular Medicine》的研究基于韩国健康人群大型队列，首次以脂肪分布视角解析菌群与代谢关联，发现内脏脂肪与Dorea longicatena、青春双歧杆菌主导的糖原合成通路关联最强；小鼠灌胃验证两株菌均可促进体重与脂肪增加并上调肝脏脂肪生成基因，为内脏肥胖的菌群精准干预提供靶点。
items.summary_en: Published September 10 in Experimental & Molecular Medicine, this analysis of a large healthy Korean cohort is among the first to examine fat distribution in microbiome-metabolic associations: visceral fat correlated most strongly with a glycogen synthesis pathway driven by Dorea longicatena and Bifidobacterium adolescentis, and oral gavage of either strain promoted weight and fat gain with hepatic lipogenic gene upregulation in mice — nominating targets for precision anti-visceral-obesity interventions.

items.title_zh: Frontiers in Nutrition试点试验：IgG引导消除饮食改变偏头痛患者肠道菌群并降低zonulin
items.title_en: Frontiers in Nutrition Pilot Trial: IgG-Guided Elimination Diet Alters Gut Microbiota and Lowers Zonulin in Migraine Adults
items.summary_zh: 发表于Frontiers in Nutrition的试点饮食干预试验显示，食物特异性IgG引导的个体化消除饮食12周后，偏头痛患者肠道菌群结构显著改变：双歧杆菌、丁酸球菌等富集而普氏菌减少，血清zonulin由399.5降至253.3pg/mL；双歧杆菌丰度升高与CGRP下降及生活质量改善相关，为菌-肠-脑轴参与偏头痛提供假说生成性线索。
items.summary_en: A pilot dietary intervention trial in Frontiers in Nutrition shows that a 12-week food-specific IgG-guided elimination diet significantly reshaped gut microbiota in migraine adults — enriching Bifidobacterium and Butyricicoccus while reducing Prevotella — and cut serum zonulin from 399.5 to 253.3 pg/mL; rising Bifidobacterium correlated with lower CGRP and better quality of life, generating hypotheses for microbiome-gut-brain involvement in migraine.

items.title_zh: 斯坦福Cell Metabolism RCT：小檗碱使餐后GLP-1提升28%，'天然GLP-1伴侣'有了硬数据
items.title_en: Stanford Cell Metabolism RCT: Berberine Raises Postprandial GLP-1 by 28%, Giving the 'Natural GLP-1 Companion' Hard Data
items.summary_zh: 斯坦福大学发表于Cell Metabolism的随机双盲试验纳入214名空腹血糖偏高成人，500mg小檗碱一日三次、16周后餐后GLP-1曲线下面积较安慰剂提升28%（p<0.001），HbA1c降0.4%，且心血管风险标志物TMAO无显著升高；研究者称其通过独立于AMPK的通路刺激肠道L细胞分泌GLP-1。专家提醒仍需重复验证，且生物利用度因人而异。
items.summary_en: A randomized double-blind Stanford trial in Cell Metabolism enrolled 214 adults with elevated fasting glucose: 500 mg berberine HCl three times daily for 16 weeks raised postprandial GLP-1 AUC by 28% vs placebo (p<0.001), cut HbA1c by 0.4%, and showed no significant TMAO elevation; investigators describe an AMPK-independent pathway stimulating intestinal L-cell GLP-1 secretion. Experts urge replication and note variable bioavailability.

items.title_zh: 麦克马斯特大学最大规模肌酸认知试验：55岁以上成人工作记忆与处理速度显著改善
items.title_en: McMaster's Largest Creatine Cognition Trial: Significant Working Memory and Processing Speed Gains in Adults 55+
items.summary_zh: 2026年9月麦克马斯特大学发表的随机对照试验纳入386名55岁以上成人，每日5g一水肌酸干预16周后工作记忆与处理速度较安慰剂组显著改善，是迄今该方向规模最大、最严谨的人体试验，把肌酸从'健身房补剂'进一步推入认知健康与长寿视野；同榜单还点名GLP-1伴侣方案（亮氨酸蛋白+肌酸+甘氨酸镁）与肽类品类监管趋严。
items.summary_en: A September 2026 randomized controlled trial from McMaster University in 386 adults aged 55+ found that 5 g/day creatine monohydrate for 16 weeks produced statistically significant improvements in working memory and processing speed versus placebo — the largest and most rigorous human trial to date, pushing creatine beyond the gym into cognitive health and longevity. The same roundup flags GLP-1 companion stacks (leucine-rich protein, creatine, magnesium glycinate) and tightening FTC scrutiny of peptide products.

items.title_zh: 美国老龄研究院尿石素A葡萄糖代谢试验启动招募：180名55岁以上成人、8周三盲设计
items.title_en: NIA Urolithin A Glucose Metabolism Trial Opens Recruitment: 180 Adults 55+, Eight-Week Triple-Masked Design
items.summary_zh: 美国国家老龄研究院（NIA）NCT06274749试验于9月8日更新为招募中，9月10日在巴尔的摩NIA临床研究单元启动：拟纳入180名55岁以上、BMI≥27的成人，随机接受尿石素A或安慰剂8周，随访含血液/尿液检测与心脏评估，主要完成目标为2027年3月31日，或将为线粒体自噬补剂的代谢获益提供高级别证据。
items.summary_en: The National Institute on Aging updated trial NCT06274749 to Recruiting on September 8, with enrollment starting September 10 at the NIA Clinical Research Unit in Baltimore: 180 adults aged 55+ with BMI ≥27 will be randomized to urolithin A or placebo for eight weeks with blood/urine testing and cardiac assessments; primary completion is targeted for March 31, 2027 — poised to deliver high-level evidence on mitophagy supplement metabolic benefits.

items.title_zh: Naturmega携SUPRIAX2磷脂键Ω-3亮相SupplySide Global：从'来源与浓度'迈向'脂质设计'
items.title_en: Naturmega Brings SUPRIAX2 Phospholipid-Bonded Omega-3 to SupplySide Global: From Source and Concentration to Intentional Lipid Design
items.summary_zh: Naturmega将在拉斯维加斯SupplySide Global 2026向北美市场首秀SUPRIAX2：其Ruby-O酶法技术将EPA/DHA共价键合至磷脂而非简单混合，每日建议份量提供450mg EPA+DHA，约为传统磷虾油两倍强度且不含贝类、口感中性。公司称Ω-3创新正从'哪里来、多浓'转向'如何设计与递送'，早期临床提示其结构脂或改善Ω-3递送与利用。
items.summary_en: Naturmega will debut SUPRIAX2 to North America at SupplySide Global 2026 in Las Vegas: its Ruby-O enzymatic technology covalently bonds EPA/DHA to phospholipids rather than blending them, delivering 450 mg EPA+DHA per serving — roughly twice conventional krill oil strength — shellfish-free with a neutral profile. The company argues omega-3 innovation is shifting from source and concentration to intentional lipid design, with early clinical work suggesting improved omega-3 delivery and incorporation.

items.title_zh: 苹果重押预防健康生态：健康App重构+Quest Diagnostics 119美元50+项血检+Health Age长寿标签
items.title_en: Apple Goes All-In on Preventive Health: Redesigned Health App, $119 Quest Diagnostics 50+ Biomarker Panel, and a Health Age Longevity Tab
items.summary_zh: 9月12日消息，苹果发布整合可穿戴数据、健康记录、实验室检测与AI指导的预防健康生态：新版健康App新增Health Age功能（综合VO2max、心率变异性、睡眠与血检评估'健康年龄'）与Longevity长寿纵向数据标签；美国用户可通过Quest Diagnostics以119美元下单覆盖50多项生物标志物的检测面板，约2000个采血点结果自动回传健康App。
items.summary_en: Reported September 12: Apple unveiled a preventive health ecosystem integrating wearable data, health records, lab testing and AI guidance. The redesigned Health app adds a Health Age feature (combining VO2 max, HRV, sleep and blood biomarkers) and a Longevity tab for longitudinal heart, sleep and movement data; US users can order a $119 Quest Diagnostics panel of 50+ biomarkers, with results from ~2,000 sites flowing automatically into the Health app.

items.title_zh: 新华社观察服贸会智慧诊疗：AI移动医疗车、AI肝胆超级医生智能体与3.2克健康监测戒指同台
items.title_en: Xinhua on CIFTIS Smart Healthcare: AI Mobile Clinic Vehicles, an AI Hepatobiliary 'Super Doctor' Agent, and a 3.2-Gram Health Monitoring Ring
items.summary_zh: 2026年服贸会健康卫生服务专题展区集中展示AI医疗落地场景：AI移动医疗车搭载眼底筛查、心电监测、超声诊断等10项车载AI产品，DR智能体基于400万例本土影像数据全流程自动出报告；AI肝胆超级医生智能体让基层医生获得接近专家水平的诊疗方案；仅3.2克健康监测戒指24小时采集6项生理参数并主动预警，健康管理正从'体检才发现'转向'日常早提醒'。
items.summary_en: The health services zone at CIFTIS 2026 showcased AI healthcare at scale: an AI mobile clinic vehicle carrying 10 onboard AI products including fundus screening and ultrasound, a DR agent built on 4 million local imaging cases that auto-generates reports, an AI hepatobiliary 'super doctor' agent giving primary care near-specialist plans, and a 3.2-gram health ring tracking six parameters around the clock with proactive alerts — shifting chronic disease management from late detection to daily early warning.

items.title_zh: 三部门联合印发《加快提供优质高效眼健康服务工作方案（2026—2030年）》
items.title_en: Three Ministries Jointly Issue the 2026–2030 Plan for Accelerating High-Quality Eye Health Services
items.summary_zh: 国家卫生健康委、国家中医药局、国家疾控局近日联合印发《加快提供优质高效眼健康服务工作方案（2026—2030年）》（国卫医政发〔2026〕22号），部署'十五五'期间眼健康工作。同批产业动态还包括华大营养'益人益方'个性化营养素发布、艾兰得智能制造项目银团贷款签约及四川集中销毁3.2亿元涉老假冒保健品。
items.summary_en: China's National Health Commission, National Administration of TCM and National Disease Control Administration jointly issued the 2026–2030 Plan for Accelerating High-Quality Eye Health Services, setting ophthalmic health priorities for the 15th Five-Year period. Concurrent industry items include BGI Nutrition's launch of personalized 'YiRenYiFang' nutrient products, a syndicated loan for Aland's smart manufacturing project, and the destruction of RMB 320 million in counterfeit supplements targeting seniors in Sichuan.

items.title_zh: 谁才真正需要心脏钙化扫描？十年6000人研究：中低风险人群获益有限，边缘风险人群最该做
items.title_en: Who Really Needs a Coronary Calcium Scan? Ten-Year Study of 6,000+ Adults: Limited Value for Many, Greatest Value at Borderline Risk
items.summary_zh: 9月12日报道的一项覆盖6000多名成年人、随访10年的研究发现，热门的冠状动脉钙化（CAC）扫描对许多人的标准心脏病风险评估几乎没有额外价值；但对于处于边缘或中等风险的患者，该扫描可能显著改变风险分层与干预决策。研究提示CAC筛查应更精准地瞄准'不确定地带'人群，而非无差别推广。
items.summary_en: A ten-year study reported September 12 covering more than 6,000 adults found that the popular coronary artery calcium (CAC) scan adds little to standard heart disease risk assessment for many people — but for patients at borderline or intermediate risk it may meaningfully change risk stratification and intervention decisions, suggesting CAC screening should be targeted at the 'uncertain zone' population rather than promoted indiscriminately.
